method.value: Analytic envelope, outflow shell, bow shocks and cloud models run in LIME; synthetic cubes sampled with observed visibilities, inverted, cleaned and restored in Miriad; compared with observed profiles by eye

evidence.quote: The synthetic images of the $^{12}$CO emission, are sampled with the observed visibilities, inverted, cleaned and finally restored, using Miriad.

key_parameters.value: 250 000 grid points, 16 iterations, image resolution 0.25 arcsec

evidence.quote: For each model, 250 000 grid points are used and the number of iterations is set to 16 to ensure convergence of the level populations.
The CO abundance is set to 1$\,\times\,10^{-4}$ in all components in the model

fitting.value: No chi-square fit; models varied component by component

evidence.quote: a full chi-square analysis is impracticable

validation.value: Qualitative comparison of spectra at central and one outflow position, and maps

evidence.quote: The aim of this study is, therefore, not to reproduce the exact shape of the line profiles in every position of the map

method.value: Optically thin LTE column density from line wings; dynamical time, momentum, kinetic energy, mechanical luminosity, mass-loss rate

evidence.quote: In the optically thin regime, the integrated emission in the line wings can be converted to a column density, assuming LTE conditions and using standard techniques

findings_qualitative.value: N2D+ is found in a ridge not associated with the outflow; N2H+ is absent toward the protostar

evidence.quote: N$_2$D$^+$ is detected in a ridge south-west from the protostellar condensation and is not associated with the outflow.

claims.experiment: Outflow extent, knots and dynamical time from SMA CO
claims.result: Dynamical time 400-500 yr; knots spaced ~100 yr

evidence.quote: the data suggest that the IRAS 15398–3359 source is very young, likely younger than 1000 years

claims.hypothesis: Which components explain the 12CO line profiles?
claims.experiment: LIME models M1-M4 with varied components
claims.result: Infall plus outflow (M3) reproduces central absorption and morphology
claims.finding: Infalling envelope plus outflow needed; cloud and shocks minor

evidence.quote: the M3 scenario can account for the main features in the line profiles both towards the central region and at offset positions in the outflow component

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Pure infall (M1) and pure outflow (M2) cannot explain the line profiles

evidence.quote: On the other hand, a pure outflow scenario (where no infall of gas is present) cannot explain the observed line profiles either.

limitations_admitted.value: Lack of single-dish data prevents quantifying short-spacing loss

evidence.quote: the lack of single-dish data prevents us from putting quantitative numbers on the effect of loss of short-spacings
